about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience delivering enterprise software across billing, financial services, ERP and higher education.

My work combines software engineering, data processing and business problem-solving. I have designed full-stack applications, APIs, automated data workflows, operational dashboards and financial reporting systems using Angular, TypeScript, C#, ASP.NET, GraphQL and SQL Server.

I am currently expanding my work into applied data science and machine learning using Python, Pandas and Scikit-learn, with a particular interest in intelligent systems, research-driven engineering and real-world data problems.

items.summary: Own end-to-end development of enterprise billing and financial software, combining full-stack engineering, SQL-based analysis, automation and reporting.
highlights: Owned the design, architecture, development and delivery of core functionality for a large-scale Managed Billing platform.
Analysed billing data using SQL during monthly bill runs, investigated billing exceptions and resolved data-quality issues with billing, finance and operational teams.
Built billing, invoice, tariff, financial operations and reporting modules using Angular, TypeScript, C#, ASP.NET, GraphQL and SQL Server.
Designed operational dashboards and Invoice/Margin Reporting capabilities for billing validation, profitability analysis and financial sign-off.
Designed an API-driven data-processing framework for validation, transformation and exception handling, eliminating 4–5 days of manual effort per billing cycle.
Managed CI/CD pipelines, releases and version control through Azure DevOps and Git.

items.summary: Managed academic datasets supporting institutional systems through data validation, reporting and quality assurance.
highlights: Managed academic datasets through data validation, reporting and quality assurance.
Collaborated with university stakeholders to investigate data issues, maintain accurate course information and improve data integrity.

items.summary: Led development activities across enterprise financial applications, owning software enhancements from requirements through production support.
highlights: Led development activities across enterprise financial applications and mentored three junior developers.

Performed root-cause analysis of production issues and implemented permanent technical solutions.
Received the Accenture Celebrates Excellence Award for project delivery and client satisfaction.

items.title: Titanic Survival Prediction
items.summary: An applied classification project exploring passenger survival using Logistic Regression and Random Forest, with a particular focus on model evaluation and data leakage.
items.problem: Can passenger characteristics be used to predict survival while maintaining a valid and leakage-free evaluation process?
highlights: Performed exploratory data analysis and data preprocessing on passenger-level data.
Developed Logistic Regression and Random Forest classification models.
Investigated data leakage encountered during model development and its effect on model evaluation.
